name: Kamp-Lintfort (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Kamp-Lintfort (a church and crossed hammers on red).
history: By deed of the Minister of the Interior of North Rhine-Westphalia of 9 December 1949 the then municipality was granted the right to bear arms, a flag (banner) and a seal; the flag shows the colours red, white and green horizontally with the arms at the centre.

features.role: Kamp-Lintfort arms — church and hammers on red
